title: Hahn-Banach Extension Theorem and Convex Sets in Banach Spaces
abstract: We prove linear functional extensions on normed vector spaces using Zorn's lemma.

sections.heading: 1. Normed Linear Spaces
sections.text:
Definition 1.3. A Banach space is a complete normed vector space.
Example 2. The space L^p([0,1]) is a Banach space for 1 <= p <= infty.

sections.heading: 2. Extension Theorems
sections.text:
Lemma 2.3. Sublinear functionals admit 1-dimensional bounded linear extensions.
Theorem 5.1. Theorem 5.1 follows from Lemma 2.3. Every bounded linear functional f defined on a subspace M of a normed space X can be extended to X preserving the norm.
Proof of Theorem 5.1. Using Definition 1.3 and Lemma 2.3, we apply Zorn's lemma.
Corollary 5.2. By Theorem 5.1, the dual space X* separates points of X.
